image_model.architecture: ImageNet ResNet50 (frozen) -> L2 normalise -> linear head
image_model.preprocessing: resize 224x224 bilinear, ImageNet mean/std, then L2-normalise the 2048-d pooled feature. Must match src/data/embeddings.py exactly or confidences are meaningless.
image_model.calibration_note: temperature scaling, T=0.831, fitted on held-out fold 0, patient-disjoint from training. Confidence is comparable across cases but is not a probability of the patient having the disease.

deferral.why_not_learned: System B (learned gate) scored AURC 0.211 vs 0.197 for the rules, and removing the reliability input improved it to 0.203. A pre-registered kill rule said ship the rules.

limitations: not a medical device; not a diagnostic tool; no regulatory clearance
203 cataract and 182 glaucoma patients in training
confidence is temperature-scaled but the underlying model is a frozen-feature linear head, not a fine-tuned backbone
referral documents used in development were synthetic
